page_title: GIR 0-1 MAL | Girona v Mallorca 01/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' Bryan Gil (Girona) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Thomas Lemar (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+4' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Thomas Lemar (Girona) receives a yellow card!
90+4' It seemed like Thomas Lemar (Girona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

90+2' The free kick is taken short by Girona. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
90+1' Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Nice individual effort by Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
90' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
90' Samu Costa (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
89' The game is interrupted now, Samu Costa (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

88' Hugo Rincon (Girona) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
87' Bryan Gil (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

84' Bryan Gil (Girona) picks up the rebound just a few yards out of the box. He attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a fine shot, but the goalkeeper is on hand to deny him. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.

83' Leo Roman was forced into action to thwart Cristhian Stuani (Girona). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
82' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

82' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Johan Mojica (Mallorca) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
81' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Lopez (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch so that Sergi Darder can be given a rest.
78' Martin Demichelis has decided to make a change. Javier Llabres (Mallorca) replaces Manu Morlanes.
78' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
76' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle as Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

75' Alejandro Frances (Girona) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
75' Thomas Lemar (Girona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
75' Thomas Lemar (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Thomas Lemar (Girona) is replacing Fran Beltran.
74' Substitution. Hugo Rincon (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Daley Blind walks off.
71' The game has come to an end for Jan Virgili. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
70' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristhian Stuani (Girona) replacing Claudio Echeverri.
70' Joel Roca comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bryan Gil (Girona).
69' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
67' Joel Roca (Girona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
66' Pablo Torre is being substituted because of an injury. Martin Demichelis sends Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) on the pitch.
64' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Vitor Reis (Girona) for his blatant foul.

62' The cross into the penalty area from Pablo Torre (Mallorca) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
62' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
59' None of the Girona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
58' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Francisco Maeso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) will miss the next game.

56' Daley Blind (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the right post! The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
54' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.

53' This was a nice effort by both teams. Joel Roca (Girona) connected with a cross from the side and slammed it straight towards the bottom left corner. Leo Roman leapt like a salmon and tipped the ball onto the post.
51' Fran Beltran (Girona) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
49' Daley Blind (Girona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
48' Joel Roca (Girona) serves up a nice cross, but Leo Roman punches the ball away.
46' Martin Demichelis has made a change at the break. Jan Virgili (Mallorca) has come on in place of Justin-Noel Kalumba.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Arnau Martinez (Girona) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
45+1' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) obviously dived. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
45+1' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

43' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Johan Mojica finds Samu Costa (Mallorca), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Paulo Gazzaniga had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
43' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
41' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' Vedat Muriqi receives a sweet cross inside the box from Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
39' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.

38' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
37' The fouls committed statistics – 4:10.
36' Joel Roca (Girona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
35' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
35' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Mallorca) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
34' Axel Witsel (Girona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
33' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) tackles a bit over-zealously and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
32' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) shoots from inside the box after his amazing individual effort. He beats the goalkeeper, but hits one of the defending players and it bounces away.
30' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
29' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) trips an opposition player and Francisco Maeso signals a foul. Mallorca win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

27' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Mallorca) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
25' Joel Roca (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
23' Daley Blind (Girona) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

23' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Girona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
22' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francisco Maeso blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.
22' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
20' Girona take a short corner kick.

20' Claudio Echeverri (Girona) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Leo Roman has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.

17' Excellent touch by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Martin Valjent (Mallorca) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Girona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
14' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.
13' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

11' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Girona are taking a throw-in.
10' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
9' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Girona get a free kick.
7' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
3' Mallorca players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
